51566.author: sbein
51566.body: This PR fixes a jet sorting issue in FastSim identified by @arizzi for Run 3 FastSim NanoAOD with Puppi jet refinement, which was originally merged here: https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49429. The above PR added refined Puppi jet quantities and sorted the main ```Jet``` table by the refined pT, but ```linkedObjects:jets``` and the MC/object association tables still followed the original jet order. In events where the refinement changes the jet ordering, some Jet_genJetIdx and MC extension rows can correspond to the wrong Jet. The proposed fix (this PR) uses a clone of the pre-refined linked-object collection for the inputs to the refiner NN, then redirects the sorted ```linkedObjects.jets``` to ```finalJetsPuppiSorted.``` ```jetPuppiTable```` consumes `linkedObjects,jets`. ## Validation Before/after plots are attached for 1000-even run of TT NanoAOD: If the PR is accepted/merged, it will need to be backported back to CMSSW_15_1, as well as throughout CMSSW_20_X. Existing samples without this fix should still be usable for physics, but gen-jet properties of reco jets should be derived by a deltaR matching and not via the genJetIdx branch.
51566.title: Fix FastSim NanoAOD jet row links

51665.author: vhegde91
51665.body:
This PR is related to HCAL HBHE data in Run 3. It adds event flaggers if there are many channels in HCAL with bad RecHits or bad Digis. It also sets severity level to HCAL bad RecHits so that they are ingored in PF reconstruction. More details about the issues (Type A) can be found in https://gitlab.cern.ch/cmshcal/docs/-/work_items/315 (private HCAL repo) and [this talk](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1712463/contributions/7211448/attachments/3322716/5949294/Eventfilters2026D_HBHERun3_HcalDPG31Jul26.pdf).
Related PR for flagging RecHits: https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51094

Very high pT jets and high MET arising from HCAL noise is expected to be mitigated.

This PR aims at Run 3 re-reco and no immediate reason for back-porting or forward-porting.

 @abdoulline
51665.title: Run 3 HBHE bad digi event filter
